mapper.select: select p.id, p.title, p.goal, p.actions, p.review_on, p.version, i.status from student_plan_publication p join intervention_plan i on i.id = p.plan_id where i.student_id = #{studentId} and i.status <> 'DRAFT' and not exists (select 1 from student_plan_publication n where n.plan_id = p.plan_id and n.version > p.version) order by p.id desc
select id, title, goal, actions, review_on, version from student_plan_publication where plan_id = #{planId} order by version desc

select p.plan_id, p.version, i.student_id, i.status from student_plan_publication p join intervention_plan i on i.id = p.plan_id where p.id = #{publicationId} and i.student_id = #{studentId} and i.status <> 'DRAFT' for update

select p.plan_id, p.version, i.student_id, i.status from student_plan_publication p join intervention_plan i on i.id = p.plan_id join student s on s.id = i.student_id join class_room c on c.id = s.class_id where p.id = #{publicationId} and c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} for update
select coalesce(max(version), 0) from student_plan_publication where plan_id = #{planId}
select id, content, occurred_on, created_at from student_plan_execution where publication_id = #{publicationId} order by id desc
select id, content, created_at from student_plan_feedback where publication_id = #{publicationId} order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into student_plan_publication(plan_id, version, title, goal, actions, review_on) values (#{planId}, #{version}, #{title}, #{goal}, #{actions}, #{reviewOn})
insert into student_plan_execution(publication_id, request_key, content, occurred_on) values (#{publicationId}, #{requestKey}, #{content}, #{occurredOn})
insert into student_plan_feedback(publication_id, request_key, content, created_by) values (#{publicationId}, #{requestKey}, #{content}, #{createdBy})
